scope: Complete original four-sided native frames with multiple numeric amount rails. Retain explicit blank physical slots and exact source cells; no OCR, Unicode restitution, arithmetic or financial hierarchy inference.
rules: Exact original vertical intervals at identical x are unioned only when overlapping or touching. Actual gaps and nearby different x values are never rounded or bridged. Both original full horizontal caps and complete continuous sides are required.

Every used native word in the full frame has one original owner and complete finite rightward horizontal-flow/baseline evidence. All words of each source row share one exact original baseline and match its complete rendered payload. Unknown, repeated, orphan, crossing, typed-grid or comparison-scope evidence declines.

All rows of the same original ordinary source unit are contiguous and nonoverlapping. Labels and complete numeric suffixes retain exact original substrings and source-word order. Glyph rectangles inside one cell can overlap; their left bounds must progress and complete cell envelopes prove disjoint global gutters.

All exact numeric right edges are inspected. A connected graph of original same-row amount co-occurrences certifies their common matrix; disjoint complete label/amount column gaps and explicit empty physical slots are retained. No local easy fragment authorizes a larger unsupported parent.
Existing single-terminal-column logic is unchanged. Unclosed frames decline because another printed column or page can introduce additional amount rails that page-local evidence cannot establish.
no_new_dispatch: No page/company/person/case-value/font-name/CID/PUA-code runtime dispatch; no fixed point tolerance, arbitrary character length or neighboring-row budget. Existing numeric and Roman-enumerator notation grammar is reused.
